description: A new leak suggests that Huawei could introduce major design changes with the Mate XT2 tri-fold smartphone. The upcoming tri-fold smartphone is said to have an inward-folding mechanism. It appears to feature a circular rear camera module. The Huawei Mate XT 2 is rumoured to be officially announced in October this year. It could run on a Kirin 9050 Pro chipset and feature a 6,000mAh battery.
title: Huawei Mate XT 2 Leaked Patent Reveals New Tri-Fold Design and Folding Mechanism

description: The codename of the Google Pixel 11a reportedly appeared in the beta version of Google’s Phone app. The upcoming handset is said to be linked to the codename Formosan. The Pixel 11a will succeed the Pixel 10a, which was released earlier this year with a Tensor G4 chipset and a 5,100mAh battery.
title: Google Pixel 11a Codename Reportedly Spotted in Phone App

description: The Redmi Note 17 Pro 5G's purported global variant has been spotted on the NBD import-export database, suggesting the smartphone could launch in international markets soon. The listing reveals its identifier, memory configurations and shipment records to Pakistan and Vietnam. A related Poco device has also appeared in the database, hinting at another rebranded model. Separately, tipster Kacper Skrzypek claims the global variant may feature an 8,340mAh battery, compared to the 9,000mAh unit on the Chinese model.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Global Variant Reportedly Appears on NBD Database Alongside Poco Model

description: Airtel has updated the terms and conditions page of its website to clarify that the telecom service provider does not allow customers to share Unlimited 5G Data via mobile hotspot. The company website clarifies that the Unlimited 5G Data offers are only meant for “personal and non-commercial use”. Further, Airtel’s website states that the telecom service provider “reserves the right” to end, suspend, modify the offer, or services “in specific cases” if the Unlimited 5G Data offers are found to be used for commercial use or “any fraudulent” purpose. Interestingly, the terms and conditions also highlight that the sharing of data, “where the customer has activated Unlimited 5G Data”, is not allowed via mobile hotspots.
title: Airtel Unlimited 5G Data Subscribers Cannot Share 5G Data via Mobile Hotspot, Company Confirms

description: Lava Virat V1 5G and Virat V1 will launch in India on July 24. The 5G version is confirmed to feature a 6,000mAh battery, while the 4G version of Virat V1 will have a 5,000mAh battery.  They will carry a 6.75-inch panel and a 13-megapixel rear camera unit. They will go on sale through Flipkart. The Lava Virat V1 5G will run on a Unisoc T8200 processor
title: Lava Virat V1 5G, Virat V1 Specifications Revealed Ahead of July 24 India Launch

description: iQOO Z11 Lite will be launched in India on July 24 at a starting price of under Rs. 20,000, the Vivo sub-brand has announced. Additionally, the dedicated microsite for the iQOO Z11 Lite has been updated to confirm that the handset will be equipped with a 6,500mAh battery, which is claimed to provide 20 hours of social media scrolling or 80 hours of music playback on a single charge. It will arrive in India with support for 44W wired fast charging. The Vivo sub-brand claims that the iQOO Z11 Lite will ship with an IP65 rating for dust and water resistance.
title: iQOO Z11 Lite Price Range in India, Key Specifications Revealed Ahead of Official Launch

description: Vivo is reportedly still evaluating the camera hardware for the X500 Ultra, according to a new leak. The flagship smartphone is said to be testing three 200-megapixel periscope telephoto sensors with different optical formats before the company finalises its imaging system. Earlier leaks also suggested Vivo had dropped a dedicated 10x periscope camera in favour of a single 200-megapixel sensor with in-sensor zoom. The handset is expected to debut in the first half of 2027.
title: Vivo X500 Ultra Leak Suggests Three 200-Megapixel Telephoto Sensors Under Testing

description: Apple is expected to launch the iPhone 18 series in September, comprising the Pro models and the iPhone Ultra. According to a recent report, the Cupertino-based tech giant could bring one of the biggest camera upgrades in recent years. The diagnostics log, which reportedly originated from the recently leaked internal Tata Electronics files, suggests that the iPhone 18 Pro Max will feature a new Sony main camera sensor with variable aperture support.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Diagnostics Log Reportedly Reveals Variable Aperture Camera, Sony Sensor Upgrade

description: Asus is gearing up to launch a new tablet in India, and the company has finally announced its launch date. The device, dubbed the Asus Pad T3201 , marks the company’s return to the tablet segment in the country in nearly a decade. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the Taiwan-based company has revealed some of its key specifications. The Asus Pad will sport a 12.2-inch OLED screen. It will be powered by a Dimensity 8300 chipset, running on Android 16. It is confirmed to pack a 9,000mAh battery.
title: Asus Pad India Launch Date Announced as Company Reveals Key Specifications

description: Samsung could bring a Galaxy S26-exclusive camera feature to the Galaxy S25 lineup through the One UI 9 update. The Galaxy S25 series is said to get the Horizontal Lock option in Super Steady mode, which will offer enhanced stabilisation. Reference about the feature reportedly spotted in the internal One UI 9 test build for the Galaxy S25+ with build number DZG4.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Series Could Get Galaxy S26’s Horizontal Lock Camera Feature With One UI 9 Update

description: Poco M8 Power and Poco X8 will be launched in India in the current quarter of this year, a tipster claims. The two Poco smartphones will reportedly arrive in the country as the rebranded versions of the Redmi Note 17 and Redmi Note 17 Pro, which were recently launched in China. The handsets are expected to be similar to the Redmi phones in terms of specifications. However, they could launch in India at a significantly higher price. In China, the Redmi Note 17 features a Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset, while the Pro model is powered by an octa core Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 SoC.
title: Poco M8 Power, Poco X8 India Launch Timeline Tipped; Could Arrive as Rebranded Redmi Note 17 Series

description: Bharti Airtel has quietly removed one of its plans for postpaid customers in India. Those looking for a higher-tier plan will now have to opt for the Rs. 699 Family plan, which includes one primary and one add-on SIM connection. Meanwhile, the Rs. 449 Individual plan remains the entry-level option for new subscribers. Although the telecom service provider is yet to issue an official statement explaining the change, the Rs. 549 postpaid plan is no longer listed on Airtel's website or within the Airtel Thanks app.
title: Airtel Quietly Removes Rs. 549 Individual Postpaid Plan in India; Rs. 699 Plan Becomes Next Upgrade

description: Lenovo has revealed key specifications of the upcoming Legion C700 handheld ahead of its August launch. The device will feature a 7.82-inch 120Hz IPS display, TMR thumbsticks, Hall Effect triggers and programmable controls. It is designed for Tencent START cloud gaming, enabling users to stream supported titles without downloading them. Lenovo has yet to disclose the processor, RAM, storage or battery capacity. The Legion C700 could initially be limited to the Chinese market.
title: Lenovo Legion C700 Teased as a Cloud Gaming Handheld Ahead of August Launch

description: Marvel's Wolverine has received a new cinematic trailer from Insomniac Games, featuring action set pieces and a first-look at a character in the game. The developer said the new trailer, which does not include gameplay, will play ahead of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey in select US theatres.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Gets New Trailer That Will Play Ahead of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey in Select Theatres

description: Meta will now alert parents if their teenager has sensitive conversations related to suicide and self-harm with Meta AI. These alerts are live now for parents using Instagram parental supervision in the US, UK, Australia and Canada. Meta confirmed that the new safety feature will be available for supervising parents globally by the end of the year. Meta is also building ways to alert first responders if someone appears to be at imminent risk of suicide.
title: Meta Introduces New Parental Alerts for Teen Suicide and Self-Harm Conversations

description: WhatsApp has begun rolling out its full username feature to a limited number of users on Android and iOS, according to WABetaInfo. The update allows eligible users to connect with new people without sharing their phone numbers while keeping phone number-based accounts intact. Users can manage their usernames from settings, receive in-chat notifications when contacts update usernames, and optionally enable a username key for added privacy. The rollout is expected to expand gradually, with wider availability planned later this year.
title: WhatsApp Usernames Are Now Reportedly Available for Some Android and iOS Users

description: Oppo K15 will be launched in China on July 24 at 10:00 am local time (7:30 am IST), the company has confirmed. The upcoming smartphone will arrive as the third model in the lineup, which currently includes the Oppo K15 Pro and Oppo K15 Pro+. A listing for the standard Oppo K15 model is now live on the tech firm’s online store in the country. It is now available for pre-order. The company has also revealed the key specifications, features, design, colour options, and storage variants of the Oppo K15. The handset will be powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Super chipset, paired with an 8,000mAh battery.
title: Oppo K15 Launch Date Confirmed; Key Specifications Revealed Ahead of Debut

description: Apple has reportedly increased orders for vapour chamber cooling components, according to a new leak. The move is said to support improved thermal management in Apple's first foldable iPhone and the next-generation 20th anniversary iPhone models. The latest post does not reveal additional hardware details, but it follows earlier rumours about advanced cooling, higher foldable iPhone production targets and a redesigned anniversary iPhone expected to launch in 2027.
title: Apple May Introduce Vapour Chamber Cooling Across Foldable iPhone and Anniversary Models, Tipster Claims

description: Samsung’s Galaxy Unpacked event is scheduled for July 22. At the bi-annual hardware showcase, the South Korean tech conglomerate is expected to unveil its next-generation foldables, which could include the highly-anticipated wide-fold model. The company, meanwhile, continues to test other unconventional foldable smartphone designs. According to a report, a new patent has been discovered for a Galaxy Z Flip-like handset that has a display that can fold both inward and outward with the help of a 360-degree hinge mechanism.
title: Samsung Patent Reportedly Shows Galaxy Z Flip Design With 360-Degree Fold, Curved Outer Display

description: 1Password has introduced 1Password for Claude, a new integration that allows Anthropic's AI assistant to sign in to websites without accessing users' passwords or one-time passcodes. The feature relies on biometric approval and securely fills credentials stored in a user's 1Password vault. The company also announced Agentic Mode, which limits AI agents to approved credentials during browser sessions. The integration is available for Mac users on Business, Family and Individual plans, with support for more data types planned later.
title: 1Password Lets Claude AI Access Your Accounts Without Revealing Passwords

description: Smartphone shipments in India declined 10 percent year-on-year (YoY) in the second quarter (Q2) of 2026, according to a report by a market research firm. It reportedly marks the steepest drop for a June quarter in six years and has been attributed to a sharp rise in smartphone prices driven by record-high memory costs. London-based Nothing emerged as India's fastest-growing smartphone brand during the quarter, while Vivo retained the top spot in terms of shipments. Samsung, meanwhile, was the only top-five smartphone brand to register annual growth.
title: Nothing Becomes India's Fastest-Growing Brand Amid Smartphone Market Slowdown in Q2 2026: Counterpoint

description: Android 17 Quarterly Platform Release (QPR) 1 Beta 7 update is now rolling out the latest Android 17 QPR1 Beta 7 update to eligible devices. According to the release notes, the Android 17 QPR1 Beta 7 update resolves an issue that caused the Battery Share option in Quick Settings to fail. The company says that the bug prevented the Battery Share feature from starting or repeatedly displayed the charging animation when a user tried to access it from the Quick Settings menu. Additionally, Google has resolved the bug that created an empty gap between the battery and cellular data icons in the Quick Settings status bar when a user tried to toggle the Wi-Fi button off.
title: Android 17 QPR1 Beta 7 Update Brings Refinements, Resolves Battery Share Bug in Quick Settings

description: Analytics firm Newzoo's data shows that that GTA 6 generated around $180 million in digital pre-orders across the US, the UK, France, Italy, Germany, and Spain in its first week of sales. The firm said the game was on pace to generate $3.3 billion to $5.2 billion in cumulative global sales by the end of its launch week.
title: GTA 6 Had 'Strongest Pre-Order Campaign on Record', on Track to Generate Up to $5.2 Billion in First Week

description: Infinix Xpad 30 Pro could launch soon. Ahead of the official announcement, a retail website has listed the tablet, revealing its colour options and specifications. It is listed in three colour options with an octa-core 6nm MediaTek Helio G200 Ultimate chipset, an 11-inch TFT 2.5K resolution panel and an 8,200mAh battery with support for 18W fast charging. The official product page for the Infinix Xpad 30 Pro briefly appeared on Infinix's website.
title: Infinix Xpad 30 Pro Listed on Retail Website With 11-Inch 2.5K Display and 8,200mAh Battery

description: Skullcandy has launched the Crusher 1080 ANC wireless headphones with Sound by Bose technologies and adjustable Crusher Bass. The headphones feature 36mm dual drivers, adaptive active noise cancellation, spatial audio with head tracking and Bluetooth 5.3 with LE Audio and Auracast support. They offer up to 60 hours of battery life, support multipoint connectivity and Google Fast Pair, and include app-based EQ customisation. The Crusher 1080 ANC is priced at $279.99 (roughly Rs. 26,900) and is available globally.
title: Skullcandy Crusher 1080 ANC Announced With With Bose Audio, Up to 60-Hour Battery: Price, Features

description: The Duskbloods, the upcoming multiplayer action title developer by FromSoftware, is getting a closed network playtest next month. The test will begin on August 21 and go on till August 24. Applications for the network test will start later this month, FromSoftware said.
title: The Duskbloods' Closed Network Playtest Will Take Place in August, FromSoftware Confirms

description: The European Commission, offering big relief to major tech giants, has now added six new product categories to the existing list of devices that are exempted from the EU Batteries Regulation 2023/1542. The rule no longer requires wearables, like smartwatches, fitness trackers, electric toys, and other devices within the scope of the ATEX Directive for “equipment used in explosive atmospheres such as explosion-proof motors, sensors, pumps, or forklift trucks”. This means that OEMs, like Apple and Samsung, do not have to launch new models of the Apple Watch and Galaxy Watch with user-replaceable batteries.
title: EU Regulator Exempts Smartwatches, Other Wearables From User-Replaceable Battery Mandate

description: Tecno Camon 50 Ultra 5G has been launched in India as the latest addition to the tech firm’s Camon series. The handset will be available for purchase in the country via Amazon. It is offered in Cypress Green, Misty Purple, and Nebula Titanium colour options. An octa core MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultimate chipset powers the new Tecno Camon series handset, along with a 6,500mAh battery, which is claimed to provide over two days of battery life. The phone supports 45W wired fast charging, too. It carries a triple rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: Tecno Camon 50 Ultra 5G Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: Google announced that users can now link and interact with some of thier go-to services right in AI Mode. Google has integrated with Canva, Instacart, and YouTube Music in the AI Mode, and it will help users complete tasks across regularly used apps. Google says it will assist users with their shopping and planning activities. Google AI Mode's integration with third-party apps is now rolling out in the US. Google said that it is working with a range of partners to add support for more apps soon.
title: Google AI Mode Now Supports More Connected Apps Including YouTube Music for Everyday Tasks

description: OnePlus has announced one of the biggest strategic shifts in its history. Following weeks of speculation, the company confirmed it will begin winding down operations in North America and Europe, meaning no new product launches are expected. While this development initially sparked concerns that India, which is one of OnePlus' biggest markets, could be next, the company has reassured customers that its India operations will continue as usual. OnePlus users will continue to receive new product launches, software updates, and after-sales support.
title: OnePlus Exits US and Europe, Continues Operations in India: 5 Things to Know

description: Apple is said to be preparing one of the biggest upgrades to the iPad mini in years. According to a report, the Cupertino-based tech giant could launch a refreshed version of its compact tablet equipped with an OLED display. The purported device is reportedly slated to debut as early as this fall, with a release expected by October. Separately, Apple is also said to be working on refreshed versions of the entry-level iPad and iPad Air with updated hardware.
title: iPad Mini With OLED Screen to Reportedly Launch in October as Apple Prepares Base iPad, iPad Air Refreshes
